description.text:
The first expansion pack of the Pokémon Card Game ADV series, released on 31 January 2003 alongside starter decks built around Treecko, Torchic and Mudkip. The series was timed to the Advanced Generation anime and brought the Pokémon of Ruby and Sapphire, a new card face without the Pokémon's level, and the first Pokémon ex, which the announcement called extra cards of outstanding strength. Packs grew to 11 cards, always with one holo and one Energy. The cards are numbered to 55. In English the set became EX Ruby & Sapphire in June 2003.

From the Battle Road Spring 2007 tournaments, ADV cards were no longer allowed in official play, except those reprinted later.
